basic_info.description: Exceptionally maintained 4-unit Edwardian at 265 Rivoli Street offers a rare chance to own a classic property in the heart of Cole Valley. Each spacious one-bedroom corner unit is filled with natural light from walls of windows and enjoys sweeping north-facing views of the Golden Gate Bridge towers, St. Ignatius Church, Angel Island, and San Francisco's cityscape. Original 1920s details include high ceilings, hardwood floors, picture moldings, and French doors. Renovated units feature granite countertops, walk-in closets, modern lighting, and updated color schemes. Layouts include inviting living rooms, dining areas with built-in bar cabinets, well-proportioned kitchens with gas ranges, and full baths. Directly across from Grattan Park with courts, fields, and playgrounds, the property provides a truly comfortable city lifestyle. Each unit has a dedicated garage space with elevated storage. An additional oversized detached garage offers future potential for development.  Close to Cole Valley's popular restaurants and cafes, UCSF Medical Center, Golden Gate Park, and the Mount Sutro Open Space Reserve. Excellent public transit options provide easy access to downtown and beyond.
